import MilneLib.Sheaf.SemilinearAlgebraModules
import Mathlib.Algebra.Module.LocalizedModule.Submodule
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Localization.Module

/-!
# Localization of invariant modules

For a finite Galois action, taking fixed vectors commutes with localization at
an invariant element. The scalar ring for localization is the fixed algebra;
thus the comparison uses the same `invariantModule` as affine module descent.
This supplies compatibility with principal-open restrictions for Milne III.1.13.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u v w

namespace MilneLib.GaloisDescent.SemilinearAction

variable (K L : Type u) [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
variable (R : Type v) [CommRing R] [Algebra K R] [Algebra L R]
  [IsScalarTower K L R] [MulSemiringAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) R]
  [IsSemilinear K L R]
variable (M : Type w) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
  [DistribMulAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) M] [SMulDistribClass (L ≃ₐ[K] L) R M]

local notation "A" => FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L)

/-- Each Galois element acts linearly over the fixed algebra. -/
def fixedScalarAction (g : L ≃ₐ[K] L) : M →ₗ[A] M where
  toFun m := g • m
  map_add' := smul_add g
  map_smul' a m := by
    change g • ((a : R) • m) = (a : R) • (g • m)
    rw [smul_distrib_smul, a.2 g]

@[simp]
theorem fixedScalarAction_apply (g : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (m : M) :
    fixedScalarAction K L R M g m = g • m := rfl

variable (f : FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L))

/-- The Galois action on the localized module, extended from its numerator. -/
noncomputable def localizedModuleAction (g : L ≃ₐ[K] L) :
    LocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers f) M →ₗ[Localization (Submonoid.powers f)]
      LocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers f) M :=
  LocalizedModule.map (Submonoid.powers f) (fixedScalarAction K L R M g)

@[simp]
theorem localizedModuleAction_mk (g : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (m : M)
    (s : Submonoid.powers f) :
    localizedModuleAction K L R M f g (LocalizedModule.mk m s) =
      LocalizedModule.mk (g • m) s := by
  simp [localizedModuleAction]

/-- The extended actions obey the group composition law. -/
theorem localizedModuleAction_mul (g h : L ≃ₐ[K] L)
    (x : LocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers f) M) :
    localizedModuleAction K L R M f (g * h) x =
      localizedModuleAction K L R M f g (localizedModuleAction K L R M f h x) := by
  induction x using LocalizedModule.induction_on with
  | h m s => simp only [localizedModuleAction_mk, mul_smul]

@[simp]
theorem localizedModuleAction_one (x : LocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers f) M) :
    localizedModuleAction K L R M f 1 x = x := by
  induction x using LocalizedModule.induction_on with
  | h m s => simp only [localizedModuleAction_mk, one_smul]

/-- Fixed vectors of the extended action form a module over the localization
of the fixed algebra. -/
def localizedInvariantModule :
    Submodule (Localization (Submonoid.powers f)) (LocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers f) M) where
  carrier := {x | ∀ g : L ≃ₐ[K] L, localizedModuleAction K L R M f g x = x}
  zero_mem' g := map_zero _
  add_mem' hx hy g := by rw [map_add, hx, hy]
  smul_mem' a x hx g := by
    rw [map_smul, hx]

/-- Pin restriction of scalars to the fixed algebra without searching for
an intermediate scalar ring through the fixed-vector subtype. -/
instance localizedInvariantModuleModule : Module A (localizedInvariantModule K L R M f) :=
  (localizedInvariantModule K L R M f).module' (S := A)

@[simp]
theorem mem_localizedInvariantModule {x : LocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers f) M} :
    x ∈ localizedInvariantModule K L R M f ↔
      ∀ g : L ≃ₐ[K] L, localizedModuleAction K L R M f g x = x := Iff.rfl

/-- A fraction with invariant numerator is fixed. -/
theorem mk_mem_localizedInvariantModule (m : invariantModule K L R M)
    (s : Submonoid.powers f) :
    LocalizedModule.mk (m : M) s ∈ localizedInvariantModule K L R M f := by
  intro g
  rw [localizedModuleAction_mk, m.2 g]

/-- Restriction of the canonical localization map to invariant vectors. -/
noncomputable def invariantLocalizationMap :
    invariantModule K L R M →ₗ[A] localizedInvariantModule K L R M f where
  toFun m := ⟨LocalizedModule.mk (m : M) 1,
    mk_mem_localizedInvariantModule K L R M f m 1⟩
  map_add' m n := Subtype.ext
    ((LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap (Submonoid.powers f) M).map_add (m : M) (n : M))
  map_smul' a m := Subtype.ext
    ((LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap (Submonoid.powers f) M).map_smul a (m : M))

@[simp]
theorem invariantLocalizationMap_coe (m : invariantModule K L R M) :
    (invariantLocalizationMap K L R M f m : LocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers f) M) =
      LocalizedModule.mk (m : M) 1 := rfl

variable [Finite (L ≃ₐ[K] L)]

omit [SMulDistribClass (L ≃ₐ[K] L) R M] in
/-- Finiteness of the Galois group gives one power clearing every failure of
invariance of a numerator. -/
theorem exists_uniform_pow_fixed (m : M)
    (h : ∀ g : L ≃ₐ[K] L, ∃ n : ℕ, f ^ n • (g • m) = f ^ n • m) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ g : L ≃ₐ[K] L, f ^ n • (g • m) = f ^ n • m := by
  classical
  letI := Fintype.ofFinite (L ≃ₐ[K] L)
  choose n hn using h
  refine ⟨Finset.univ.sup n, fun g => ?_⟩
  have hle : n g ≤ Finset.univ.sup n := Finset.le_sup (Finset.mem_univ g)
  have he : Finset.univ.sup n = (Finset.univ.sup n - n g) + n g := by omega
  rw [he, pow_add, mul_smul, mul_smul, hn g]

/-- Every fixed fraction admits an invariant numerator after multiplying its
numerator and denominator by a common power of the invariant element. -/
theorem exists_invariantModule_numerator
    (x : LocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers f) M)
    (hx : x ∈ localizedInvariantModule K L R M f) :
    ∃ (m : invariantModule K L R M) (s : Submonoid.powers f),
      LocalizedModule.mk (m : M) s = x := by
  induction x using LocalizedModule.induction_on with
  | h m s =>
      have hclear : ∀ g : L ≃ₐ[K] L, ∃ n : ℕ, f ^ n • (g • m) = f ^ n • m := by
        intro g
        have hg := hx g
        rw [localizedModuleAction_mk] at hg
        obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := LocalizedModule.mk_eq.mp hg
        have ht' : ((t * s : Submonoid.powers f) : A) • (g • m) =
            ((t * s : Submonoid.powers f) : A) • m := by
          simpa only [Submonoid.smul_def, Submonoid.coe_mul, mul_smul] using ht
        obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (t * s).2
        refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
        simpa only [← hn] using ht'
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_uniform_pow_fixed K L R M f m hclear
      have hfixed : f ^ n • m ∈ invariantModule K L R M := by
        intro g
        change fixedScalarAction K L R M g (f ^ n • m) = f ^ n • m
        rw [map_smul]
        exact hn g
      let t : Submonoid.powers f := ⟨f ^ n, ⟨n, rfl⟩⟩
      exact ⟨⟨f ^ n • m, hfixed⟩, t * s, LocalizedModule.mk_cancel_common_left t s m⟩

/-- The canonical comparison sends each invariant fraction to the same
fraction in the localization of the original module. -/
noncomputable def invariantLocalizationComparison :
    LocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers f) (invariantModule K L R M)
      →ₗ[Localization (Submonoid.powers f)] localizedInvariantModule K L R M f :=
  (LocalizedModule.map (Submonoid.powers f) (invariantModule K L R M).subtype).codRestrict _
    (fun x => by
      induction x using LocalizedModule.induction_on with
      | h m s =>
          rw [LocalizedModule.map_mk]
          exact mk_mem_localizedInvariantModule K L R M f m s)

omit [Finite (L ≃ₐ[K] L)] in
@[simp]
theorem invariantLocalizationComparison_mk (m : invariantModule K L R M)
    (s : Submonoid.powers f) :
    (invariantLocalizationComparison K L R M f (LocalizedModule.mk m s) :
      LocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers f) M) = LocalizedModule.mk (m : M) s := by
  exact LocalizedModule.map_mk _ _ _ _

/-- The comparison on invariant fractions is bijective. -/
theorem invariantLocalizationComparison_bijective :
    Function.Bijective (invariantLocalizationComparison K L R M f) := by
  constructor
  · intro x y h
    exact LocalizedModule.map_injective (Submonoid.powers f)
      (invariantModule K L R M).subtype Subtype.val_injective (congrArg Subtype.val h)
  · intro x
    obtain ⟨m, s, h⟩ := exists_invariantModule_numerator K L R M f x.1 x.2
    exact ⟨LocalizedModule.mk m s, Subtype.ext (by
      rw [invariantLocalizationComparison_mk, h])⟩

/-- Invariants commute with localization at an invariant element, as modules
over the localized fixed algebra. -/
noncomputable def invariantLocalizationEquiv :
    LocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers f) (invariantModule K L R M)
      ≃ₗ[Localization (Submonoid.powers f)] localizedInvariantModule K L R M f :=
  LinearEquiv.ofBijective (invariantLocalizationComparison K L R M f)
    (invariantLocalizationComparison_bijective K L R M f)

@[simp]
theorem invariantLocalizationEquiv_mk (m : invariantModule K L R M)
    (s : Submonoid.powers f) :
    (invariantLocalizationEquiv K L R M f (LocalizedModule.mk m s) :
      LocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers f) M) = LocalizedModule.mk (m : M) s :=
  invariantLocalizationComparison_mk K L R M f m s

/-- The restriction of the localization map is itself localization of the
invariant module, in Mathlib's canonical localized-module interface. -/
theorem isLocalizedModule_invariantLocalizationMap :
    IsLocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers f) (invariantLocalizationMap K L R M f) := by
  let e := (invariantLocalizationEquiv K L R M f).restrictScalars A
  have h : invariantLocalizationMap K L R M f =
      e.toLinearMap.comp
        (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap (Submonoid.powers f) (invariantModule K L R M)) := by
    ext m
    exact (invariantLocalizationEquiv_mk K L R M f m 1).symm
  rw [h]
  exact IsLocalizedModule.of_linearEquiv _ _ e

end MilneLib.GaloisDescent.SemilinearAction
